ModMetaData.name: RWU Extension Portable Void Monolith
ModMetaData.author: SomaLancet / Codex
ModMetaData.description: Makes the Anomaly void monolith portable through RimWorld's normal uninstall/reinstall system and carries the complete monolith on Odyssey gravships. Rotated landings rebuild its attachments in the correct orientation, and transporting the surviving monolith no longer fails its quest when the departed map is destroyed. Includes optional runtime compatibility with Void Universe without requiring it.
